verdict.rationale: Veriff can be driven entirely headlessly through its Public API. You create sessions via the API, can collect and submit end-user media yourself instead of using the UI flow, and get results through decision polling or HMAC-signed webhooks. For CI, it provides test integrations that do not count toward paid usage and lets you trigger decisions for test sessions. Missing for 10: an official CLI or published OpenAPI spec (the probe found all paths 404), explicit CI/headless automation guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration; batch testing is only available case by case.
